response.rationale: The order is still in_transit and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so the standard return window (RET-007) has not begun and its condition cannot be satisfied. No return can be processed for an undelivered item. Final-sale (RET-012) does not apply since final_sale is false, defective (RET-020) does not apply since defective is null/not true, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present. Since the item has not been delivered, it is not currently eligible for return; the customer should wait until delivery, after which the 30-day standard window (RET-007) would apply.
